Example Dataset for Joint ODE Model

Source: R/data.R
sim.Rd

A simulated dataset generated using the Joint ODE Model framework, demonstrating heterogeneous patient dynamics with longitudinal biomarker measurements and survival outcomes.

Usage

sim

Format

A list with two components:

data

A list containing the simulated data:

longitudinal_data

Data frame with longitudinal measurements (938 observations):

  • id: Patient identifier (1-200)

  • time: Measurement time

  • observed: Observed biomarker (with error)

  • biomarker: True biomarker value

  • velocity: First derivative

  • acceleration: Second derivative

  • x1, x2: Longitudinal covariates

  • xi: Patient-specific damping ratio

  • period: Patient-specific natural period

survival_data

Data frame with survival outcomes (200 patients):

  • id: Patient identifier

  • time: Event or censoring time

  • status: Event indicator (1=event, 0=censored)

  • b: Shared random effect

  • w1, w2: Survival covariates

state

Data frame with initial states (200 patients):

  • biomarker: Initial biomarker value

  • velocity: Initial velocity (0)

init

A list containing initial parameter values:

coefficients

True parameter values used in simulation:

  • baseline: B-spline coefficients for baseline hazard

  • acceleration: ODE acceleration parameters

  • hazard: Hazard function coefficients

  • measurement_error_sd: Measurement error SD (0.15)

  • random_effect_sd: Random effect SD (0.1)

configurations

Model configuration:

  • baseline: B-spline configuration

  • autonomous: TRUE (autonomous ODE system)

Source

Generated using .create_example_data() with seed 12345

Details

The dataset contains 200 patients with heterogeneous dynamics. The patients are divided into four groups based on their xi and period values:

  • Underdamped (xi=0.3, period=5): oscillatory behavior

  • Critically damped (xi=0.707, period=5): optimal damping

  • Critically damped (xi=1.0, period=3): faster dynamics

  • Overdamped (xi=2.0, period=3): exponential decay

The "true" parameters stored in init$coefficients correspond to the first group's dynamics for model fitting demonstration.

See also

JointODE for model fitting, simulate for data generation

Examples

# Load the data
data(sim)

# Examine structure
str(sim, max.level = 2)
#> List of 2
#>  $ data:List of 3
#>   ..$ longitudinal_data:'data.frame':	1052 obs. of  8 variables:
#>   ..$ survival_data    :'data.frame':	200 obs. of  6 variables:
#>   ..$ state            :'data.frame':	200 obs. of  2 variables:
#>  $ init:List of 2
#>   ..$ coefficients  :List of 5
#>   ..$ configurations:List of 2

# Access longitudinal data
head(sim$data$longitudinal_data)
#>   id time    observed  biomarker  velocity acceleration         x1          x2
#> 1  1    0 -2.79942312 -2.7839729 0.0000000    7.2321290  2.1988103 -0.07355602
#> 2  2    0 -2.56412731 -2.7564971 0.0000000    6.9335995  1.3124130 -1.16865142
#> 3  3    0 -2.77761580 -2.9318655 0.0000000    4.7960334 -0.2651451 -0.63474826
#> 4  3    1 -1.50566115 -1.6516048 1.7229930   -0.2872333 -0.2651451 -0.63474826
#> 5  3    2 -0.06333283 -0.2920281 0.8934965   -0.9602711 -0.2651451 -0.63474826
#> 6  3    3  0.27244963  0.1964349 0.1718727   -0.4493786 -0.2651451 -0.63474826

# Summary of survival outcomes
summary(sim$data$survival_data$time)
#>     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
#>  0.03756  1.33573  3.31031  4.96458 10.00000 10.00000 
table(sim$data$survival_data$status)
#> 
#>   0   1 
#>  66 134 

# Patient dynamics distribution
dynamics <- sim$data$longitudinal_data[
  !duplicated(sim$data$longitudinal_data$id),
  c("id", "xi", "period")
]
#> Error in `[.data.frame`(sim$data$longitudinal_data, !duplicated(sim$data$longitudinal_data$id),     c("id", "xi", "period")): undefined columns selected
table(dynamics$xi, dynamics$period)
#> Error: object 'dynamics' not found

# Visualize different dynamics behaviors
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

# Select example patients from each dynamics group
dynamics_groups <- sim$data$longitudinal_data %>%
  group_by(xi, period) %>%
  summarise(example_id = first(id), .groups = "drop")
#> Error in group_by(., xi, period): Must group by variables found in `.data`.
#> Column `xi` is not found.
#> Column `period` is not found.

example_ids <- dynamics_groups$example_id
#> Error: object 'dynamics_groups' not found

# Plot trajectories for different dynamics
plot_data <- sim$data$longitudinal_data %>%
  filter(id %in% example_ids) %>%
  mutate(
    dynamics_type = case_when(
      xi < 1 ~ "Underdamped (Oscillatory)",
      xi == 1 ~ "Critically Damped",
      xi > 1 ~ "Overdamped (Exponential)"
    ),
    label = paste0("xi=", xi, ", T=", period)
  )
#> Error in filter(., id %in% example_ids): ℹ In argument: `id %in% example_ids`.
#> Caused by error:
#> ! object 'example_ids' not found

# True trajectories
p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time, y = biomarker)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = dynamics_type), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observed), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Biomarker Trajectories for Different Dynamics Groups",
    subtitle = "Lines: true values, Points: observed with measurement error",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Biomarker Value",
    color = "Dynamics Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
#> Error: object 'plot_data' not found

print(p1)
#> Error: object 'p1' not found

# Phase plane plot (velocity vs biomarker)
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = biomarker, y = velocity)) +
  geom_path(aes(color = dynamics_type), size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_data, time == 0),
             size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Phase Plane Trajectories",
    subtitle = "White circles indicate initial states",
    x = "Biomarker",
    y = "Velocity",
    color = "Dynamics Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
#> Error: object 'plot_data' not found

print(p2)
#> Error: object 'p2' not found

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Fit a Joint ODE model using this data
fit <- JointODE(
  longitudinal_formula = observed ~ x1 + x2,
  survival_formula = Surv(time, status) ~ w1 + w2,
  longitudinal_data = sim$data$longitudinal_data,
  survival_data = sim$data$survival_data,
  state = as.matrix(sim$data$state)
)
summary(fit)
} # }
